salmanshh_line_renderer.name: Line Renderer
salmanshh_line_renderer.description: Draw a Sprite or Tiled Background as a line, rope or beam along a path of points using mesh distortion, in 2D or 3D.

initialPointCount.name: Initial point count
initialPointCount.desc: The number of points the line starts with. They are spread across the object so it initially looks unchanged.

endCapStyle.name: End caps
endCapStyle.desc: The shape of the start and end of the line. None cuts off at the end point; Square and Round extend by half the thickness.

ribbonFacing.name: Facing
ribbonFacing.desc: How the width of the line is oriented in 3D. Flat stays in the layout plane, Billboard faces the camera, Up vector follows the up vector.

autoFit.name: Auto-fit to line
autoFit.desc: Absolute co-ordinate space only: after each update, size the object to the unrolled line (length by thickness) at the line's centre. This makes a Tiled Background tile at its own image scale and scroll with its own image offset.

joinStyle.name: Joins
joinStyle.desc: How corners between segments are drawn. Simple is cheapest but thins at corners, Miter is sharp, Bevel is chipped, Round is rounded.

crossSection.name: Cross-section points
crossSection.desc: The number of points around the line. 2 draws a flat ribbon; 3 or more draws a 3D tube (joins become Simple).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the behavior is initially enabled.

SetFacing.description: Set how the line width is oriented in 3D. Flat stays in the layout plane. Billboard faces the camera: X, Y, Z give a camera position, or all 0 to use the 3D Camera object. Up vector follows the up direction given by X, Y, Z.

x.name: X
x.desc: Camera X (Billboard) or up vector X (Up vector).

y.name: Y
y.desc: Camera Y (Billboard) or up vector Y (Up vector).

z.name: Z
z.desc: Camera Z elevation (Billboard; all 0 = automatic) or up vector Z (Up vector).

SetLineStyle.display-text: Set {my} line style to end caps {0}, joins {1}, cross-section points {2}
SetLineStyle.description: Set the shape of the line ends, how corners are drawn, and the number of points around the line (2 = flat ribbon, 3 or more = 3D tube).

caps.name: End caps
caps.desc: None cuts off at the end point; Square and Round extend by half the thickness.

joins.name: Joins
joins.desc: Simple, Miter, Bevel or Round corners.

crossSection.name: Cross-section points
crossSection.desc: Points around the line: 2 for a flat ribbon, 3 to 32 for a tube.

SetAutoFit.description: Enable or disable sizing the object to the unrolled line (texture length by thickness) after each update (absolute co-ordinate space only).

SetCoordSpace.description: Set whether points are in layout co-ordinates (absolute) or relative to the object (relative).

space.name: Co-ordinate space
space.desc: Absolute uses layout co-ordinates. Relative uses co-ordinates relative to the object's position, angle and size.

SetWave.display-text: Set {my} wave to magnitude {0}, wavelength {1}, period {2}, {3}, {4}
SetWave.description: Set the wave that ripples the line: how far points move, the length of one wave, seconds per cycle, the direction points are pushed, and the wave shape.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.desc: How far points are pushed, in pixels. 0 turns the wave off.

wavelength.name: Wavelength
wavelength.desc: The length of one full wave along the line, in pixels.

period.name: Period
period.desc: Seconds for one full cycle. The wave travels one wavelength per period; 0 keeps it still, negative reverses it.

movement.name: Movement
movement.desc: The direction points are pushed in.

SetWaveMagnitude.description: Set how far the wave pushes points, in pixels. 0 turns the wave off; animate it to fade a wave in or out.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.desc: How far points are pushed, in pixels.

PinPointsToObjects.description: Replace all points with one per picked instance of an object (in picking order) and, when pinned, keep each point following its instance every tick.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object whose picked instances become the points. At least two instances are needed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Pinned keeps following the instances every tick. Once only sets the points now.

PinPointToObject.display-text: Pin {my} point {0} to {1} image point {2} on face {3} ({4})
PinPointToObject.description: Move a point to an image point of the first picked instance (with its Z elevation) and, when pinned, keep following it every tick. Setting a point past the end adds points up to it.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object to pin the point to.

imagePoint.name: Image point
imagePoint.desc: The image point name or number to follow (0 is the origin).

face.name: Face
face.desc: For 3D shapes, the face the image point is on. None for other objects.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Pinned keeps following the instance every tick. Once only moves the point now.

SetPointToNode.description: Move a point to the position of a mesh or bone node of the first picked 3D model instance, including its Z elevation.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The 3D model object to take the node from.

nodeType.name: Node type
nodeType.desc: Whether the node name refers to a mesh or a bone.

UnpinPoint.description: Stop a point following its pinned instance (the point keeps its position). Use -1 to unpin all points.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point, or -1 for all points.

SetArc.display-text: Set {my} arc at ({0}, {1}) radius {2} from {3} to {4} degrees with {5} segments
SetArc.description: Replace all points with an arc around a position.

cx.name: Center X
cx.desc: The X co-ordinate of the center of the arc.

cy.name: Center Y
cy.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the center of the arc.

radius.name: Radius
radius.desc: The radius of the arc, in pixels.

segments.name: Segments
segments.desc: The number of straight segments used for the arc.

SetBezierCurve.display-text: Set {my} bezier curve from ({0}, {1}) via ({2}, {3}) and ({4}, {5}) to ({6}, {7}) with {8} segments
SetBezierCurve.description: Replace all points with a cubic bezier curve.

x1.name: Start X
x1.desc: The X co-ordinate of the start of the curve.

y1.name: Start Y
y1.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the start of the curve.

c1x.name: Control 1 X
c1x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the first control point.

c1y.name: Control 1 Y
c1y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the first control point.

c2x.name: Control 2 X
c2x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the second control point.

c2y.name: Control 2 Y
c2y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the second control point.

x2.name: End X
x2.desc: The X co-ordinate of the end of the curve.

y2.name: End Y
y2.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the end of the curve.

segments.name: Segments
segments.desc: The number of straight segments used for the curve.

SetLine.description: Replace all points with a straight line between two positions.

x1.name: Start X
x1.desc: The X co-ordinate of the start of the line.

y1.name: Start Y
y1.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the start of the line.

z1.name: Start Z elevation
z1.desc: The Z elevation of the start of the line.

x2.name: End X
x2.desc: The X co-ordinate of the end of the line.

y2.name: End Y
y2.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the end of the line.

z2.name: End Z elevation
z2.desc: The Z elevation of the end of the line.

SmoothLine.description: Replace the points with a smooth curve passing through them.

subdivisions.name: Subdivisions
subdivisions.desc: The number of points added between each pair of existing points.

SetPerformance.display-text: Set {my} maximum drawn points {0}, wave resolution {1}, off-screen culling {2}
SetPerformance.description: Limit how many points are used to draw the line (0 = all), set how many mesh steps each segment is split into for the wave, and whether updates are skipped while the line is off-screen.

maxPoints.name: Maximum drawn points
maxPoints.desc: The maximum number of points used to draw the line, or 0 for all.

waveResolution.name: Wave resolution
waveResolution.desc: Mesh steps per segment (at least 1). Use more for a smooth wave on long segments.

culling.name: Off-screen culling
culling.desc: Skip updating the line while it is off-screen.

SetAllPointsSize.display-text: Set {my} size of all points to ({0}, {1})
SetAllPointsSize.description: Set the width (texture width per segment: 0 = automatic, a value fixes it) and height (line thickness) of every point. Use -1 to keep a value.

width.name: Width
width.desc: Texture width per segment, in pixels: 0 = automatic, a value fixes it, -1 = keep.

height.name: Height
height.desc: The line thickness, in pixels, or -1 to keep.

SetPointPosition.description: Set the position and Z elevation of a point. Setting a point past the end adds points up to it.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the point.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the point.

z.name: Z elevation
z.desc: The Z elevation of the point (relative to the object in relative space, layout Z elevation in absolute space).

SetPointSize.description: Set a point's width (texture width of the segment starting at it: 0 = automatic, a value fixes it so the image stretches with the segment) and height (line thickness). Use -1 to keep a value.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

width.name: Width
width.desc: Texture width of the segment, in pixels: 0 = automatic (constant density), a value fixes it, -1 = keep.

height.name: Height
height.desc: The line thickness at this point, in pixels, or -1 to keep.

AddPoint.description: Add a point to the end of the line.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the point.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the point.

z.name: Z elevation
z.desc: The Z elevation of the point (relative to the object in relative space, layout Z elevation in absolute space).

height.name: Height
height.desc: The line thickness at this point, in pixels (like the object height).

InsertPoint.description: Insert a point at an index, moving later points up by one.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index to insert at.

x.name: X
x.desc: The X co-ordinate of the point.

y.name: Y
y.desc: The Y co-ordinate of the point.

z.name: Z elevation
z.desc: The Z elevation of the point (relative to the object in relative space, layout Z elevation in absolute space).

height.name: Height
height.desc: The line thickness at this point, in pixels (like the object height).

RemovePoint.description: Remove the point at an index. A line always keeps at least two points.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

SetEnabled.description: Enable or disable the line. While disabled the object is drawn normally.

SetPointCount.description: Set the number of points in the line, adding points at the end or removing points from the end.

count.name: Count
count.desc: The new number of points (at least 2).

OnMeshRebuilt.description: Triggered after the line's mesh has been updated.

OnPointCountChanged.description: Triggered when a point is added or removed.

ComparePointCount.description: Compare the number of points in the line.

cmp.name: Comparison
cmp.desc: How to compare the point count.

count.name: Count
count.desc: The number of points to compare to.

IsCoordSpace.description: True if the line uses the given co-ordinate space.

space.name: Co-ordinate space
space.desc: The co-ordinate space to compare to.

IsEnabled.description: True if the line is currently enabled.

IsPointPinned.description: True if the point is following a pinned instance.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

IsWaveActive.description: True if the wave magnitude is greater than 0.

LineLength.description: The length of the line, in pixels.

PointCount.description: The number of points in the line.

PointHeight.description: The line thickness at a point, in pixels.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

PointWidth.description: The texture width of the segment starting at a point, in pixels: its fixed width if set, otherwise its current length.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

PointX.description: The layout X co-ordinate of a point.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

PointY.description: The layout Y co-ordinate of a point.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

PointZ.description: The layout Z elevation of a point.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The zero-based index of the point.

TextureLength.description: The texture length of the line, in pixels (the object width after Auto-fit). Equals LineLength unless some segments have a fixed width.

Wavelength.description: The length of one full wave along the line, in pixels.

WaveMagnitude.description: How far the wave pushes points, in pixels.
